output.reason: On its own, the one-line changelog entry [ev-1f885c8c6418] is vague, but the linked issue and PR fill the gap. Issue #21014 [ev-86d220b13a7d][ev-1939ea5eff25] names the trigger: applications that use manifestGeneratePaths, where the synced revision is not in the repo-server's local clone. It also names the symptom: sync fails with "failed to diff ... git diff --name-only ... fatal: Invalid revision range" (retried 3 times). PR #21015 [ev-af0ca5b0bcbe][ev-efcf77c17828] gives the fix: the repo-server's UpdateRevisionForPaths now checks whether syncedRevision exists in the local git repo and fetches it, with changes only in reposerver/repository/repository.go. Together these give a concrete subject (repo-server manifest-generate-paths revision handling), change (bug fix), applicability (apps using manifestGeneratePaths) and consequence (the sync failure goes away), enough to write the typed assertion.
